description: This file contains the implementation of an Azure-specific real-time language model (LLM) service that extends a more generic OpenAIRealtimeLLMService. It includes initialization with Azure-specific parameters and a websocket connection method customized for Azure WebSocket endpoints.

classes.name: AzureRealtimeLLMService
classes.description: Azure OpenAI Realtime LLM service with Azure-specific authentication, extending the base OpenAIRealtimeLLMService to incorporate Azure WebSocket endpoints and headers.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, base_url: str, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the AzureRealtimeLLMService with Azure-specific parameters including API key and base URL.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes a websocket connection to the configured Azure WebSocket endpoint, handling errors and connection setup.

ctags.name: websocket_connect
